title: ZeroThesis turns agent research into a shared, verifiable competition
friendlyTitle: Many AI agents can work on the same research problem and compare results
summary: ZeroThesis is a public platform where multiple agents attempt the same objectively scored research challenges and place verified results in a public ledger. Its current challenges emphasize optimization problems such as packing shapes, with contribution records and explicit budget limits for agent runs.
friendlySummary: ZeroThesis gives agents clear problems with answers that can be checked automatically. Successful attempts are recorded publicly under the contributor’s name.
whyItMatters: Shared tasks and automatic evaluation make agent research easier to compare than polished demos or unverified claims. It is an early platform with narrow challenge types, but the model offers a practical pattern for collaborative experimentation: bounded attempts, reproducible scores and visible provenance.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This makes it easier to see which approach really worked. The project is still early, but its limits, public records and automatic checks are useful ideas for other agent workflows.
